# gpupaas_security_group (Resource)

A security group (`dev.envmgmt.io/v1` `SecurityGroup`): the set of rules that decides which traffic may reach the instances that use it. At project or workspace scope. The platform has no update for a security group: changing any argument deletes the group and creates it again, so detach it from instances first. Name it from a VM, bare-metal machine or cluster with `security_group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A security group in a workspace: the rules say which traffic may reach the instances that use it. The platform
# has no update for a group: other rules replace it, so detach it from instances first.
resource "gpupaas_security_group" "web" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "web"
    project   = "system-catalog"
    workspace = "team-a"
  }

  spec = {
    rules = [
      { source_cidr = "0.0.0.0/0", application = "ssh", protocol = "tcp", action = "allow" },
      { source_cidr = "10.0.0.0/8", application = "https", application_port = "443", protocol = "tcp", action = "allow" },
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Where the security group lives. Changing any of these replaces it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<workspace>/<name>`, or `<project>/<name>` for a project-scoped group.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the security group.
- `project` (String) Project that owns the security group.

Optional:

- `workspace` (String) Workspace that owns the security group; omit for a project-scoped one. It must already exist.


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `rules` (Attributes List) The access rules, in order. Changing them replaces the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--rules))

Optional:

- `sharing` (Attributes) Resource sharing across workspaces or projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `application` (String) The service the rule is for, such as `ssh`, `http` or `https`.
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol, such as `tcp`.
- `source_cidr` (String) Source address range, such as `0.0.0.0/0` or `10.0.0.0/8`.

Optional:

- `application_port` (String) Port, when the service needs one that is not its default.


<a id="nestedatt--spec--sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.sharing`

Required:

- `share_mode` (String) Sharing mode (e.g. `ALL_WORKSPACES`, `SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`, `SPECIFIC_PROJECTS`).

Optional:

- `projects` (Attributes List) Project sharing entries when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_PROJECTS`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing--projects))
- `workspaces` (List of String) Workspaces shared with when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--sharing--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.sharing.projects`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `workspaces` (List of String)




<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `reason` (String)
- `status` (String) Platform status, `success` once the group is stored.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# <project>/<workspace>/<name>, or <project>/<name> for a project-scoped group
terraform import gpupaas_security_group.web system-catalog/team-a/web
```
